standard-dialogue-after-completing-the-f.player: Hello there. You're a long way from home.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-the-f.npc: Well what sort of Fremennik are you if you don't travel! Besides, we heard this was the land to visit for breaking skulls and spilling blood!

steps.text: If the player is a Rookie:

steps.npc: Of course! Have you not visited the Colosseum? You won't regret it if you do.

steps.player: Hmm... I might have to check it out.

steps.text: If the player is Brawler or higher:

steps.npc: Ha! As if you didn't know! We've heard about your exploits in the Colosseum! Maybe you'll see us next time you're there!
